subject: english
stem:
The town pool now opens at seven. It also offers a morning class and a quiet lane for older swimmers. These changes have brought more people before work.
What should a careful reader choose?
options: new morning choices at the town pool

optionRationales.reason: why people avoid water：後文說更多人來，而非避開。
new morning choices at the town pool：開放時間、晨間課與泳道都在說明泳池新增的早晨選擇。
seven o'clock：只涵蓋第一項開放時間。
every sports center：文章沒有談其他運動中心。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「能涵蓋多句的共同對象，而非只出現一次的細節」可推出 new morning choices at the town pool；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 new morning choices at the town pool 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
